versions.changelog:
- Adds a new "Start on APIDot" section for direct entry points from ClawHub.
- Updates guidance to clarify recommended URLs for model page, API docs, dashboard, and examples.
- Removes the file skill-card.md.
- Documentation remains non-executable; usage instructions and security guidance unchanged.

Initial release of documentation-only skill for APIDot Kling 2.1 API usage.

- Provides routing and integration guidance for Kling 2.1 Standard/Pro via APIDot, including async video generation workflow, task_id handling, polling, and webhook delivery.
- Contains detailed security rules for API key handling and workflow best practices.
- Includes model routing, usage scenarios, and links to official APIDot docs, model pages, and examples.
- No executable scripts, network calls, or credential storage are included—skill is documentation and reference only.
